notes.title: Devlog: Map
notes.content:
Development continues and now I'm ready to show parts of the game map.
[list]
[*] Approximate ratio of map scale of the demo version and the main game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/ead4c8b6f16d2267b472b76b53205f8392eb1963.png[/img]

[*] As before, the map consists of several biomes - forests, fields, swamps. The wasteland biome has been added to them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/62265d41ebe63b9d5f2906021f05729ee2677e94.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/5fbcff6e76e775232856826ae306f8362b3d73b3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/7ffbbc0ba5290481cca2220d73a53efe9cdfdf45.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/0c023245b59503b889826cb5e6b548b1f64cba97.jpg[/img]

[*] There will be several points of interest on the map with their own loot list and enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/bf7f4d61dd0d93f67559740e96d494111c3d45fb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/a859c832ed573e1092b4c8072e97a4d9aa75f9e4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/184a8d1bcd661c394eb9266a55825669a01f691d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/c34d79cf85e51ca18af20a6e0c1255ea7f8dcf28.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/b13f83b688a8b99d8d8b85fd40362391d13f2e4d.jpg[/img]

[*] Some areas will have a high radioactive and toxic background, and it will be possible to enter there safely only with special equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/1ee12941397e802144e89382558ec2d8e54fd4f1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/af841aa21f18b6576b6a61039101355ad508dd22.jpg[/img]

[*] The entire map is divided into locations. It is possible to move from one location to another from certain sectors on the border of the location. Also, the game will have guides who can quickly and relatively safely guide the player from one location to another for a fee.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.23
notes.content:
- Added the option to rest for 5 minutes
- Updatied merchants' goods and amount of money
- Slight acceleration of the combat process
- Reduced the cost of using the kitchen to 100 rubles
- New items and recipes
- Added the option of extracting wood with a machete
- Added numerical value of skill and stat progress on the character screen
- Combat mechanics with no limit on the number of attacks
- Added the probability of finding shell casings on the ground after a gun battle
- Reduced animation time of some actions
- Updated game interface and notifications

Old saves will not work, you need to start a new game

notes.title: Demo Update - Changelog
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug when crafting items
- Hypothermia damage has been reduced
- Added a new item and 2 recipes
- Reduced chance of encountering a large pack (x5) of wolves 
- A three-hour sleep in the settlement barracks creates a game save

notes.title: Demo Update - Changelog
notes.content:
- Added a [b]list of recipes[/b] for crafting.
- [b]Tooltips[/b] in the crafting menu.

- Mine and workshop pay has been [b]increased[/b].

notes.title: Demo Update - Changelog
notes.content:
- Added [b]tooltips[/b] over items in inventories. The mode can be switched using the button in the inventory interface or the Shift key.
- Added the possibility of [b]autosave[/b] when quitting the game. Along with this feature, the game has received a few more changes, so old saves will not work.
- Added a character [b]statistics[/b] screen. To open it, you need to go to the journal and select the statistics tab.
- Added recipes for [b]crafting[/b].
- As well as small changes regarding the [b]interface[/b] and [b]quests[/b].

notes.title: Encounters
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/e016646fe42ae03ef16f9f42f14f97122528dadf.jpg[/img]
[b]During the course of the game, a character may encounter other inhabitants of this world. These can be groups of raiders, faction patrols or loners. Some of them are neutral and you can trade with them or get valuable information. Others may demand something or simply attack. Gangs and factions have different requirements for those in their territory. These may include banning certain items or charging a fee for passage.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/035163428661317598c44e7ed4cf8ed44824c3c2.jpg[/img]
[b]In addition, the character may encounter wild animals and mutants. Wild animals are most often found in forested areas, and the farther the character goes away from populated areas, the more numerous and dangerous the animals encountered can be.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/dc712a01f62dbe8abf79d7b52933f8f2a4495a05.jpg[/img]
[b]Spiders belong to mutants and are found in swamps. The time of day also affects the activity of animals and mutants.[/b]

notes.title: In-game events
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/49f7b2cf76e3c6879bfd33c883ec6580de1fa398.jpg[/img]

[h3]During the course of the game, an event may start that changes the conditions of the game or makes it more difficult.[/h3]

[list]
[*] [h3]Solar flare[/h3] Exposure to radiation throughout the location except for safe or underground structures. 

[*][h3]Toxic precipitation[/h3] If it starts raining during the event, a player with insufficient protection against toxins will start getting poisoned.

[*] [h3]Eclipse[/h3] Reduced natural light and consequently more difficult searches.

[*] [h3]Aggressive animals[/h3] Increased chance of animal attacks, in places where they may be.

[*] [h3]Gang activity[/h3] Increased chance of ambush or encounter with raiders.

[*] [h3]Cold snap[/h3] A sudden drop in temperature. Warm clothes or warming up by the fire will help prevent frostbite.
[/list]
[h3]The duration and power of an event can have different meanings.[/h3]

notes.title: Enemies
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/971bdde4c2f26fe58929413b22f35fb0760cbe47.jpg[/img]
[h3]A few enemies/monsters/mutants from the game.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemies and monsters vary in their amount of hp, damage, armour and accuracy.
[*] Loot from enemies is not random, but based on their weapons and equipment.
[*] Carcasses of animals and mutants can be butchered. People and mushroomers (zombie analogue) can be searched.
[*] Activity of certain enemies depends on the time of day.
[*] Spiders can poison a character when attacking, and wolves can cause bleeding.
[*] Monsters have different probabilities of detecting a character. Some react more to the visibility of the character, while others react to the amount of noise they make.
[/list]

notes.title: Campfire
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/92ab8d08a711b6ccc25cdeb583c3fe77f73cd70c.png[/img]
[b]To start a fire you will need an igniter (matches, lighter or firestriker) and fuel (any wood).
The chance of successfully making a fire depends on your survival skill, using tinder will increase that chance. And the rain significantly reduces the chance of starting a campfire.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/c090829a80a0a024a09b322a2b81c97e392dcf7f.png[/img]
[b]When the fire is lit, you can cook food and get warm. And by putting out the flames you can get some charcoal, which is used in crafting.[/b]

notes.title: Melee weapons
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/276c83b66a278db331659201cd32a3abc5eef10a.png[/img]

[h3]Melee weapons have less damage than firearms, but require less action points to attack.[/h3]

notes.title: Crafting and cooking
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/8ba920bbbed660336d3dafc3927e4e3872465b85.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/991293a1ed6d3bbb7a56ad00609550c0c3b0e3af.png[/img]

[h3]A few crafting and cooking recipes.[/h3]
[list]
[*] [h3] Water. [/h3] Water must be boiled at the campfire/kitchen before use.
[*][h3] Food.[/h3] Cooked food gives more bonuses, but takes time and effort.
[*] [h3] Dismantling.[/h3] Some items can be disassembled into components.
[/list]

notes.title: Ruinlander firearms list
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803156/25f5c32432dda865b41f3d7c92dfcd2f2b71645a.png[/img]

[h3]Game development is underway and now I am ready to show the weapons presented in the game.[/h3]

[list]
[*] [h3]Parameters. [/h3] Each weapon has a value for damage, accuracy, weight, and cost.

[*][h3] Action points. [/h3] Action points required for a shot (single, aiming or burst) vary greatly depending on the type of weapon.

[*] [h3]Rarity. [/h3] Rarity affects how often weapons and ammo will be found during a search or appear at vendors. Some weapons can only be obtained by completing quests or with a certain faction reputation.

[*] [h3] Ammunition.[/h3] Weapon uses only cartridges corresponding to its caliber.
[/list]
